name: Rory McPherson
story: Rory McPherson was a Stantec GIS Analyst when he documented automation of Wellington Water beforeUdig requests. His 2019 presentation described a workflow using ArcGIS Pro, Python and FME to turn a repeated utility-information task into an automated process.
